named_events.event_name: External RITC to Syndicate 3330 (managed by Coverys)
named_events.loss_description: On 14 February 2018 HUL entered in to a RITC agreement for each run-off year to transfer the assets and liabilities to Syndicate 3330's 2018 year of account managed by Coverys Managing Agency Limited. Each agreement specified the RITC premium to be paid by year of account, as calculated by the bidder based on reserve valuation following a detailed due diligence exercise and associated unallocated expense uplift.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2017 were GBP 62.137m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior year development of approximately GBP 5.13m (c. 8.3% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development in older underwriting years (notably 2011-2014) partially offset by favourable development on 2015. Major 2017 natural catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma and Maria) hit the 2017 underwriting year; prior-year movements were influenced by adverse claims development and reinsurance/portfolio run-off dynamics including RITC activity.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) amount derived from the gross claims development triangle on page 47 (calculated across UW years <=2015). The report does not provide a single explicit gross "movement in prior year's provision" figure; narrative amounts quoted in the Managing Agent's Report are frequently net of reinsurance. The RITC of the run-off years and reinsurance items may distort direct interpretation of development; some event impacts are only stated net of reinsurance (flagged where used).
